Now produce final answer.<|end_think|>Let the three generating vectors of the right parallelepiped be  

\[
\vec u,\; \vec v,\; \vec w,
\]

where  

* \(|\vec u|=a,\; |\vec v|=b\) and the angle \(\angle(\vec u,\vec v)=\alpha\) (the base is a parallelogram),  
* \(\vec w\) is orthogonal to the base, i.e. \(\vec w\perp\vec u,\;\vec w\perp\vec v\).  
Denote \(h=|\vec w|\) – the height of the prism.

---

### Lengths of the diagonals

* **Base diagonals**  

  \[
  \begin{aligned}
  d_{\text{large}}&=|\vec u+\vec v|
   =\sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}+2ab\cos\alpha},\\
  d_{\text{small}}&=|\vec u-\vec v|
   =\sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}-2ab\cos\alpha}.
  \end{aligned}
  \]

* **Body (space) diagonals of the parallelepiped**  

  Because \(\vec w\) is orthogonal to \(\vec u,\vec v\),

  \[
  |\vec w\pm\vec u\pm\vec v|^{2}=h^{2}+|\vec u\pm\vec v|^{2}.
  \]

  Hence there are two distinct lengths:

  \[
  \begin{aligned}
  D_{\text{large}}&=\sqrt{h^{2}+|\vec u+\vec v|^{2}}
  =\sqrt{h^{2}+a^{2}+b^{2}+2ab\cos\alpha},\\[2mm]
  D_{\text{small}}&=\sqrt{h^{2}+|\vec u-\vec v|^{2}}
  =\sqrt{h^{2}+a^{2}+b^{2}-2ab\cos\alpha}.
  \end{aligned}
  \]

---

### Given condition

The problem states that the larger diagonal of the base equals the smaller diagonal of the whole parallelepiped:

\[
|\vec u+\vec v|=D_{\text{small}}.
\]

Squaring and cancelling the common terms \(a^{2}+b^{2}\) gives

\[
a^{2}+b^{2}+2ab\cos\alpha
  =h^{2}+a^{2}+b^{2}-2ab\cos\alpha
  \;\Longrightarrow\;
  h^{2}=4ab\cos\alpha .
\]

Since the angle \(\alpha\) is acute, \(\cos\alpha>0\) and the height is

\[
h=2\sqrt{ab\cos\alpha}.
\]

---

### Volume

The volume of a right parallelepiped equals the area of its base times the height:

\[
\begin{aligned}
V &= (\text{area of base})\times h
   = (ab\sin\alpha)\times h \\
  &= ab\sin\alpha\;\bigl(2\sqrt{ab\cos\alpha}\bigr) \\
  &= 2ab\sin\alpha\,\sqrt{ab\cos\alpha}.
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus the volume can be written as  

\[
\boxed{V = 2ab\sin\alpha\sqrt{ab\cos\alpha}}
\qquad\text{or}\qquad
\boxed{V = 2\,(ab)^{3/2}\sin\alpha\sqrt{\cos\alpha}}.
\]

Both expressions are equivalent and give the required volume in terms of the given parameters \(a,\;b\) and the acute angle \(\alpha\).<|eot_id|> <|end_of_text|>
